summary: Baraga County, Michigan: steel fire tower about 110 ft east of L'Anse, in use by 1929 and listed as Down; no removal account found.

facts.design: Four-legged steel tower about 110 ft (33.5 m) with a small house on top (1956 survey); the Michigan directory records no cab
facts.status_note: Michigan fire tower directory lists status as Down; no removal date or account in sources read

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1956 survey describes a small house on top of the tower; the Michigan directory record says 'T. Cabin: no'. The story reports the disagreement and does not pick one.

sources.title: Arvon - Forest Lookouts
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (easternuslookouts.weebly.com); reproduces a 1956 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description and 1929-1932 L'Anse Sentinel items

notes_for_editor: No build date found; the earliest mention is October 1929. No removal date or account found; 'Down' on the Michigan directory is the only status evidence, and the brief's 'gone' rests on it. Michigan directory 'T. Cabin: no' conflicts with the 1956 survey's small house on top. The Mount Arvon conservation-easement articles (mlive returned 403; a WDET search snippet) concern the state's highest peak, a different place, and were not used. A Facebook comment (not read) says the tower is gone; not cited.
